Survival game workbench

Pick what you want to work in. Create holds the editors for building and tuning things. Game is where the pieces are played.

Create

Editors. Change how something looks or moves and see it straight away.

Character EditorReshape, recolour and re-time a character, then walk and fight with it. Creature EditorWild boar, deer, bear, snake, moose and wolf: proportions, features, colours, how they move and how they warn before attacking. Object EditorOne world object at a time: trees, rocks, furniture, machines. Size, shape, surface and colour. Environment EditorA whole patch of world: biome, ground, which objects grow there, how dense and how open. Walk through it. Base EditorBuild a base piece by piece: floors, walls, doors, windows and furniture. Closed rooms get a roof that fades when you walk in. Grass EditorThe meadow alive: swaying blades, rolling bands of light, flowers, and the colours of the ground. Tune it and hand it to the game. Hird EditorThe people who join you: roll a hirdman, tune the stat ranges, traits, jobs, food and the claim stone's reach, and hand it to the game. Item EditorSwords, axes, picks, knives and bows: material, size, sharpness, glow, twist and curl, with a name and a tale. Give them to the game. Song EditorThe game's music, played by its own instruments: the meadow by day and by evening, with a fight layer. Tempo, key, tracks and notes, and export as .mid. Sea EditorBoard a ship at the jetty and sail the archipelago. Four Viking ships, with handling, island sizes and sea distances to tune.

Game

Playable pieces. There is no single game build yet, so each system has its own page.

Combat ArenaFight wolves, boars, snakes and the bear. The gameThe first island: chop trees, mine stone, hunt the boar, and keep what you find.
